resources.string: Frames a second and janky frames for the app in front, while measuring. Tap to start or stop.
Shows whether the screen is being kept awake and for how long. Tap to switch.
Draws the dock beside the camera above the status bar, so that it can be tapped there. It reads nothing on the screen and sees nothing you type.

Shows what the app in front is made of. Only while you have started X-ray from its tile, it reads the boxes on that app\'s screen (their kinds, names, places and a few words of their text) and draws their outlines over it. It never reads what is typed in a password field. Nothing is written down and nothing leaves the phone: a reading is held in memory until the next one, until you close X-ray or forget it on X-ray\'s page, or until the screen goes off. Switched on but not started, it reads nothing.
